title: Subgaussian Fourier observations
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$, and let $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. For a uniformly random $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$, put $X=f(x)\prod_{i\in S}x_i$ and $\widehat f(S)=\mathbb E[f(x)\prod_{i\in S}x_i]$. The centered observation $X-\widehat f(S)$ has subgaussian moment generating function with parameter $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the Boolean cube to signs
$S$ is a subset of the coordinate indices
$x$ is uniformly distributed on the Boolean cube
